scope: Authorized bounded CPU-only PRM pilot; no actor updates, no C/D RL, no formal replication-gate decision
checkpoint_selection: fixed final step 32 only; no efficacy-based tuning or extension
pilot_deviations: 16 initial-policy training questions x 4 instead of formal 512 x 4
128 labeled anchors instead of formal 2048; class balanced
CPU FP32 instead of GPU BF16; rescore original B in the same FP32 backend
Frozen B-6M groups for exploratory advantage replay instead of formal 64 x 8 initial-policy validation probe
Stratified ProcessBench subset for bounded diagnostics, not the official full benchmark
A/B outcomes were observed before pilot; diagnostic error cases were already inspected
